The most frustrating part is that customers are expected to keep chasing Nykaa for a problem that should have been resolved days ago. Instead of focusing on my child, I’ve been forced to waste my time repeatedly calling customer care, only to hear the same meaningless assurances. This is not customer service—this is harassment through delays and false promises.

Nykaa seems to be very efficient at selling products but completely irresponsible when it comes to supporting customers after payment has been made. The company has failed to provide even the most basic level of service by arranging a simple return pickup.

I deeply regret purchasing this product from Nykaa. This experience has completely shattered my trust in the brand. If this is how customers are treated after making a purchase, I will think many times before ordering from Nykaa again, and I certainly cannot recommend it to friends or family.

To anyone planning to buy bulky or expensive products from Nykaa, be extremely cautious. If something goes wrong, be prepared for endless follow-ups, scripted responses, and absolutely no accountability.
